_comment: Code registry for conformance/admission/v1 (POST /incarnations, PUT /manifests/{host_id}, POST /admissions/{frame}), under the error envelope of ADR bh-hq-pio.5. Each entry: the HTTP status, retryable, and the message clients see in error.message; the real reason for a refusal is in error.details.reason. A code session/v1, heartbeat/v1 or registration/v1 also lists (stale_revision, path_invalid, authority_failed, unprovisioned_principal, beadyard_mismatch, host_manifest_unavailable, beat_not_fresh, no_current_beat, candidate_expired, request_malformed, deadline_exceeded, request_unavailable) keeps its entry there. Normative, no Python reference: Python has no write endpoints. 409 for every rule refusal; 400 for a body or path that never reaches a rule; 409 retryable for a lost race; 500 only for a commit that cannot be read back. Owned by the corpus, not either implementation.

caller_not_bound.message: the caller is not bound to the frame or host this request names

incarnation_invalid.message: the incarnation body is not principal, epoch and expected_revision in their forms

manifest_invalid.message: the body is not a valid host manifest

admission_invalid.message: the admission request or the authority it would publish is invalid

public_key_invalid.message: the runtime public key is not one OpenSSH ssh-ed25519 line

host_id_mismatch.message: the manifest names another host than the path

manifest_frame_mismatch.message: the host's committed manifest names another frame

manifest_incomplete.message: admission needs a committed manifest with frame_id, instance_ref, release and capabilities

config_unreadable.message: the committed config publication does not verify against the authority's config binding

incarnation_epoch_invalid.message: the epoch is neither a frame's next epoch nor 0 for a principal the authority has never named

incarnation_reserved.message: the committed authority already names this incarnation

incarnation_registered.message: the principal registry already routes this principal or incarnation

working_set_dirty.message: the committed working set has uncommitted changes

publish_busy.message: another publication holds the writer lock; retry

committed_unreadable.message: the publication committed but the authority does not read back; see details.reason and details.revision

operator_signature_required.message: a signed fleet's authority publication needs the operator's signature over the new record

admission_conflict.message: the frame already has an active or pending incarnation

identity_in_use.message: the runtime key or the holder already belongs to an incarnation in the authority

principal_moved.message: the registry routes this incarnation under another principal than the committed authority derives

no_pending_candidate.message: the frame has no pending candidate to admit

admission_not_declared.message: the candidate's desired state is not declared

registration_missing.message: the incarnation has no accepted registration

registration_mismatch.message: the accepted registration is not this incarnation's, or differs from the grant's release or capabilities

beat_evidence_invalid.message: an accepted beat does not verify as this incarnation's

beats_insufficient.message: admission needs three consecutive verified beats

release_mismatch.message: the beat's release is not the grant's

conformance_not_conformant.message: the beat's signed conformance status is not conformant

conformance_profile_mismatch.message: the beat's signed conformance profile is not the grant's

conformance_checks_missing.message: the beat's signed conformance carries no checks

conformance_check_failed.message: a check in the beat's signed conformance failed

free_sessions_exceed_capacity.message: the beat's free_sessions is outside the registered capacity

active_incarnation_exists.message: another active incarnation would have to be superseded, which admission does not do

session_never_renewed.message: the incarnation's session was never renewed

session_stale.message: the incarnation's session is older than the liveness policy allows

liveness_policy_invalid.message: the liveness policy holds a TTL outside 1 second to 7 days
